title: 2.1.251 regression: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 strips CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from hooks and Bash subprocesses
outputText: 2.1.251 regression: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 strips CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from hooks and Bash subprocesses; parent still writes relocated /tmp/scrubprobe (.claude.json, projects/, sessions/); SessionStart hook grep '^CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=' is 0; Bash tool env | grep -c CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR prints 0; children resolve ~/.claude; nothing printed about the removal; --debug log contains no message; dual-home; config-dir-lie; silent-drop; unlogged; hook-blind; bash-blind; scrubbed
